title: GPT Image 2 joins the image models
summary:
GPT Image 2 was added with quality and transparency options, while existing image models got routing and error-handling fixes.

Added `gpt-image-2` with text and image inputs, a 1024-pixel default, quality settings, and an optional transparent background. The image request schema and generated API docs now include it.

`gptimage` and `gptimage-large` requests were rerouted to Azure East US 2. Azure 403 responses from the GPT Image call now reach clients as 502 upstream errors with the original error text preserved, rather than looking like a client permission error.

The app showcase and catalog were refreshed. A follow-up restored named GitHub credits for contributors to Scene2Text, AI Models Laboratory, Reporay, and other listed apps after generic links appeared in the README.

highlights.title: GPT Image 2 added
highlights.text: Generate with `gpt-image-2` using text or image inputs. Choose `quality` from low, medium, high, or hd, and use `transparent` for a transparent background. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-image-2).
